hf.title: Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation
hf.abstract: Tactile sensing is an indispensable modality for contact-rich dexterous manipulation, a capability that hints at the ultimate frontiers of embodied intelligence. However, commercially available tactile sensors are still at a relatively early stage of development, with each type of sensor offering irreplaceable strengths alongside its own drawbacks. A key challenge is thus to free tactile understanding from sensor-specific physics, so that embodied models can effectively leverage heterogeneous tactile data. To this end, we develop LingBot-Touch, a tactile foundation model characterized by the following properties. (i) Our model yields a unified representation across different tactile sensors (i.e., piezoresistive, magnetic, and visuotactile sensors), and is easily extensible to new sensor types. (ii) The resulting tactile tokens are plug-and-play: they can be seamlessly integrated into policy models across paradigms, from diffusion policy to vision-language-action (VLA) models such as π_{0.5} and LingBot-VLA, consistently enhancing manipulation dexterity. (iii) Extensive experiments, spanning simulation and real-robot deployments across multiple hardware platforms, demonstrate that our tactile representation substantially benefits complex manipulation tasks while maintaining strong computational efficiency. We believe the findings in this work demonstrate the potential of leveraging cross-sensor data to scale tactile learning, and offer encouraging insights for the design of future hardware and embodied models.
hf.titleZh: 面向通用灵巧操作的异构触觉表征学习
hf.summaryZh: 商用触觉传感器类型多样、物理特性各异，触觉理解难以跨传感器复用，限制了具身模型对异构触觉数据的利用。LingBot-Touch 触觉基础模型将压阻式、磁式与视触觉传感器的信号映射为统一触觉 token，并可扩展到新传感器类型；这些 token 以即插即用方式接入扩散策略与π_{0.5}、LingBot-VLA 等 VLA 模型。仿真与多硬件平台真机实验显示该方法在复杂操作任务上带来稳定增益，同时保持较高计算效率，为跨传感器规模化触觉学习提供了思路。
hf.reason: 灵巧操作与 VLA 属机器人具身方向，按画像归低分

hf.title: WorldFoundry: Towards Unified Infrastructure for World Intelligence
hf.abstract: Visual generative models increasingly blur the line between synthesizing observations and simulating environments. Yet visual plausibility alone does not constitute successful world modeling: compelling outputs may lack persistent state, physical dynamics, or causally consistent responses to interactions. We define a generative world model as a predictive dynamical system that maintains a persistent, history-conditioned representation of an environment, updates that representation in response to actions or interventions, and generates temporally coherent trajectories that reflect outcomes under observed and counterfactual interventions. From this definition, we derive an intelligence-oriented framework spanning perceptual grounding, persistent state modeling, controllable transformation, dynamics-aware prediction, and closed-loop interaction. We present WorldFoundry, open-source infrastructure for reproducible inference and evaluation across video, 3D and 4D, embodied action, and interactive world systems. WorldFoundry unifies model and benchmark discovery, runtime and asset preparation, execution orchestration, artifact management, and interactive visualization, while modality-specific adapters preserve native inputs, execution semantics, output representations, and evaluation protocols. Explicit manifests, durable artifact contracts, and evidence-aware scorecards separate execution readiness from evaluative claims, making each claim traceable to its supporting artifacts. The catalog contains 270 model entries, 74 benchmarks, and 62 registered metric entries, with readiness and execution evidence recorded separately. WorldFoundry enables reproducible comparison of persistent, controllable dynamics across heterogeneous systems, advancing the field from perceptual synthesis toward measurable world intelligence.
hf.titleZh: WorldFoundry：迈向世界智能的统一基础设施
hf.summaryZh: 把生成式世界模型定义为一种预测性动力系统：它维护持久的、以历史为条件的表示；该表示会随动作或干预而更新，并生成时间上连贯、在观测与反事实干预下都一致的轨迹。据此提出一个面向智能的框架，其环节包括感知落地、持久状态建模、可控变换、动力学感知预测与闭环交互。WorldFoundry 将这些环节落实为开源基础设施：统一模型与基准发现、运行时与资产准备、执行编排、产物管理和交互式可视化，并以显式 manifest、持久产物契约和带证据的评分卡，把“可执行就绪”与“评估结论”分开；目录收录 270 个模型条目、74 个基准、62 项注册指标。该平台使异构系统的持久、可控动力学得以可复现地比较。
hf.reason: 面向视频、3D 和具身世界模型的评测基础设施，偏离 LLM 主线

hf.title: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
hf.abstract: We introduce Sage-Taiyi, a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific understanding to guide what to investigate next and how to investigate it. Through explicit monitoring and control, the system revises its understanding of evidence, assumptions, and unresolved questions, then uses these assessments to adapt research targets and select reusable reasoning methods. On Taiyi-Bench, an AI co-scientist ideation benchmark comprising 265 tasks from 50 papers across ten disciplines, Sage-Taiyi ranks first on all eight metrics of historical rediscovery and open-ended ideation, achieving an Overall score of 54.0 compared with 47.9 for the strongest baseline, AI Scientist-v2. It also performs well on two external scientific ideation benchmarks. Five expert-guided collaborations further connect its proposals to experimental and computational validation across chemistry, materials science, and engineering. In chemistry, reaction-condition optimization raises the yield of cobalt-catalyzed carbonylation from trace amounts to 84% and photocatalytic allylic amination from 13% to 69%. These results support metacognitive regulation as an approach to scientific ideation and its progression toward practical validation.
hf.titleZh: Sage-Taiyi:一个面向科学发现的元认知架构
hf.summaryZh: 针对科学发现中该研究什么、如何研究的决策问题，提出元认知启发的 Sage-Taiyi 架构:通过显式监控与控制修正对证据、假设和未解问题的评估，据此调整研究目标并选用可复用的推理方法。在涵盖10个学科、50篇论文、265个任务的 AI co-scientist 构思基准 Taiyi-Bench 上，八项指标全部第一，Overall 54.0 超过最强基线 AI Scientist-v2 的 47.9，并在两个外部科学构思基准上表现良好。五项专家协作将其提案推进到实验与计算验证:钴催化羰基化收率从痕量提升至84%，光催化烯丙基胺化从13%提升至69%。
hf.reason: 科研智能体与元认知架构，直接命中 AI for Research 方向

hf.title: Reframe: Observation-Aligned Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Visual Reasoning
hf.abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) offer complementary routes to post-training. For visual agents, however, tool use presents two related challenges. Models may overlook useful tool-returned observations, while poorly grounded actions can limit the evidence available for subsequent distillation. We introduce Reframe, a post-training framework that treats the observation state, rather than only the output distribution, as an object of alignment. First, Ground-Drop-GRPO (GD-GRPO) trains spatial and temporal specialists with evidence-aware rewards and stochastic removal of the original visual input, encouraging them to acquire grounded evidence and use the returned observations. Second, Observation-Gated-MOPD (OG-MOPD) replaces deficient tool actions with canonical ones mid-rollout and resumes distillation from the repaired observation. The two stages complement each other, as learning to rely on tool-returned observations can help the policy benefit from observation repair. Neither stage requires a task-specific SFT cold start. Extensive experiments over 14 image and video benchmarks demonstrate that Reframe outperforms both Mix-RL and vanilla MOPD. Ablation results show that GD-GRPO increases observation dependence and tool gain compared with outcome-based GRPO.
hf.titleZh: Reframe：面向智能体视觉推理的观测对齐多教师在线策略蒸馏
hf.summaryZh: 视觉智能体在工具调用上存在两类问题：模型可能忽略工具返回的观测，而工具调用定位不当又会限制后续蒸馏可用的证据。Reframe将观测状态而非仅输出分布作为对齐对象：GD-GRPO用证据感知奖励与随机移除原始视觉输入训练时空专家，OG-MOPD则在rollout中途将错误工具动作替换为规范动作并从修复后的观测继续蒸馏。在14个图像与视频基准上优于Mix-RL与vanilla MOPD，消融显示GD-GRPO相比基于结果的GRPO提升了观测依赖与工具增益，且两阶段均无需任务特定SFT冷启动。
hf.reason: 多教师在线策略蒸馏+Agentic视觉推理，命中后训练与Agent方向

hf.title: Flide: Accelerating Decision Inference with Exact State Forking
hf.abstract: Decision models such as Jev have emerged as a highly promising paradigm for LLM agent systems, providing lightweight and reliable categorical reasoning for rapid System One execution. However, existing generation-oriented inference engines fail to support these workloads effectively, suffering from severe prefix recomputation overheads or distorted output probabilities. To address this challenge, we propose Flide, an efficient and exact inference engine that decouples the logical tree structure of a decision request from its physical execution within a single flattened token stream. Through ForkAttention, Flide navigates request dependencies using GPU-resident indices across both standard attention and recurrent Gated DeltaNet layers, guaranteeing in exact arithmetic that every query branch evaluates identically to an isolated forward pass. By expressing branch topologies directly in GPU-resident metadata, Flide accommodates diverse request mixtures with a compact set of pre-recorded execution graphs while enabling expanding agent histories to resume from checkpoints saved in earlier passes. Extensive evaluations on public hybrid and decision models demonstrate that Flide answers queries up to 9.5 times faster than vLLM and SGLang while staying closest to a float32 reference in total variation distance. By unifying physical execution throughput with mathematical exactness, Flide establishes a principled foundation for scalable, latency-critical decision intelligence in agent systems.
hf.titleZh: Flide：以精确状态分叉加速决策推理
hf.summaryZh: 面向 Jev 等决策模型的推理请求天然呈树状分支，现有生成式推理引擎会造成严重的前缀重算，或使输出概率失真。Flide 把请求的逻辑树结构与单一扁平 token 流中的物理执行解耦：ForkAttention 借助 GPU 常驻索引，在标准 attention 与循环 Gated DeltaNet 层上导航分支依赖，保证每个分支在精确算术下与独立前向等价；分支拓扑直接写入 GPU 元数据，以少量预录执行图覆盖多种请求混合，并支持仍在扩展的 agent 历史从早期检查点续算。在公开混合模型与决策模型上，其查询速度最高达 vLLM 与 SGLang 的 9.5 倍，总变差距离也最接近 float32 参考。该工作把物理执行吞吐与数学精确性统一起来，为 agent 系统中低延迟的决策智能提供了可扩展基础。
hf.reason: 推理引擎与 Agent 决策模型，精确分支加速系统性强

hf.title: ReproBridge: Building Reproducibility into ML Research Artifacts
hf.abstract: Reproducing machine learning experiments requires reconstructing procedures from information scattered across papers, released code, and supporting artifacts. For coding agents, reproduction success can therefore depend on their ability to fill in missing details, rather than on the released artifacts alone. We ask whether preserving recovered procedures and decisions improves subsequent independent reproduction. We define a standardized artifact design comprising a refined codebase, environment setup, experiment launchers, and a reproduction guide, and introduce ReproBridge, an agent workflow for constructing these refined reproducible artifacts. ReproBridge-Bench provides 1,029 tasks from 387 experiments across 36 papers, anchored by five human-verified reference scores per task. Agents attempt tasks in fresh sessions with raw code or refined artifacts; a separate Auditor checks execution evidence. Across four evaluated models, refined artifacts raise mean reproduction success from 76.4% to 92.6% and reduce downstream API spending by 19.7% on average. The cross-model success-rate spread narrows from 21.6 to 3.9 percentage points, with all four models achieving mean success rates above 90%. Removing any component reduces success in the ablation study, with the largest losses from code and environment removal. These results suggest that preserving execution knowledge helps even models with lower raw-code success reproduce experiments more reliably and at lower API cost.
hf.titleZh: ReproBridge:把可复现性构建进机器学习研究工件
hf.summaryZh: 针对从论文、代码与附属工件重建 ML 实验时信息散落、复现成败取决于编码智能体能否补齐缺失细节的问题，提出标准化工件设计(精炼代码库、环境配置、实验启动脚本、复现指南)与 ReproBridge 智能体工作流，并构建 ReproBridge-Bench:含 36 篇论文、387 个实验的 1029 个任务，每个任务配 5 个人工核验参考分，由独立 Auditor 校验执行证据。四个模型上精炼工件把平均复现成功率从 76.4% 提升至 92.6%，下游 API 开销平均降 19.7%，跨模型成功率差距由 21.6 收窄到 3.9 个百分点;消融中移除代码或环境组件损失最大。表明保留执行知识能让能力较弱的模型也以更低成本可靠复现实验。
hf.reason: Agent 工作流加复现基准，命中 Agent 与评测方向，扎实但非范式级

hf.title: InfraRSI: Harnessing Recursive Self-Improvement for Training Infrastructure
hf.abstract: While Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) accelerates isolated algorithm and kernel synthesis, distributed LLM training depends on tightly coupled launch settings, operator kernels, and communication schedules, where single edits often hit out-of-memory (OOM) boundaries, compiler conflicts, measurement jitter, or silent numerical drift. We present InfraRSI, the agentic harness that turns open-ended human commands into verified training optimizations via a five-stage workflow: init locks editable scope and a fixed task contract over workload, loss, and timing invariants to prevent reward hacking, doctor profiles baseline phases and calibrates cluster noise, run co-optimizes launch knobs and code patches before re-verifying top candidates against the baseline and logging findings to a cross-hardware experience bank, and report and apply audit source paths, track failed-trial costs, and commit promoted changes. Rather than stepping greedily from a single incumbent, InfraRSI initializes from diverse experience-seeded configurations and fits global execution-time and censored peak-memory models across all trials, including OOMs. Using these models, it prices per-setting memory costs, revises miscalibrated LLM priors from live runs, and pairs memory-hungry optimizations with memory savers and verified code patches. Across four single- and multi-node dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLM workloads, InfraRSI achieves a speedup of up to 2.75times and lifts mean Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) from 17.4% to 30.0%, outperforming existing tuners and coding agents while transferring experience across GPUs. As it improves training infrastructure efficiency, InfraRSI forms a two-level Recursive Self-Improvement loop---revising priors online within runs and distilling experience across clusters---to push foundation model scaling.
hf.titleZh: InfraRSI:借助递归自我改进优化训练基础设施
hf.summaryZh: 分布式 LLM 训练中，启动参数、算子 kernel 与通信调度紧密耦合，单点改动易触发 OOM、编译器冲突、测量抖动或隐蔽的数值漂移。InfraRSI 把这套调优流程做成 agentic harness:五阶段工作流依次锁定可编辑范围与固定任务契约、对基线做阶段画像并校准集群噪声、联合优化启动旋钮与代码补丁并复核候选、审计并提交改动;同时从多样化经验种子配置出发，对全部试验(含 OOM)拟合全局执行时间与截尾峰值内存模型，据此为每个配置的内存开销定价并在线修正 LLM 先验。在四个单机与多机稠密/MoE 负载上取得最高 2.75 倍加速，平均 MFU 从 17.4% 提升到 30.0%，优于现有调优器与编码智能体，且经验可跨 GPU 迁移。
hf.reason: Agent 自动优化分布式训练基础设施，命中系统效率与自进化方向

hf.title: Infrathon: Benchmarking Language Agents for Real-World, Long-Horizon AI Infra Optimization
hf.abstract: In this work, we study whether frontier agent can continually improve real-world AI infrastructure over long horizons. We introduce Infrathon, a benchmark of diverse, long-horizon AI infrastructure optimization tasks across different levels. We evaluate six models across 150 runs with 24-hour budgets, totaling over 10,000 GPU-hours. Our results show that model rankings vary with the evaluation horizon, while 135 of the 150 runs achieve further improvements during the second half of their budgets. These findings indicate that shorter evaluations can overlook both optimization gains and changes in relative model performance. We also find agents can discover solutions that outperform human-designed baselines: Claude Opus 5.5 increases the mean KV-cache compression ratio from 6.82% with the human-designed Quant-VideoGen codec to 19.86%. Analysis of agent trajectories identifies task violations, unreliable testing, and premature completion as barriers to sustained improvement. Together, Our Infrathon framework provide resources for constructing long-horizon tasks, evaluating frontier agents, and discovering good infrastructure solutions.
hf.titleZh: Infrathon:面向真实场景长程 AI 基础设施优化的语言智能体基准
hf.summaryZh: 现有评测难以判断语言智能体能否在长程预算下持续改进真实的 AI 基础设施。Infrathon 构建了覆盖不同层级的长程 AI 基础设施优化任务集，让 6 个模型各跑 150 次、每次 24 小时预算，累计超过 10000 GPU 小时。结果显示模型排名随评估时长变化，150 次运行中有 135 次在预算后半段仍取得改进，短程评测会同时低估优化收益与模型相对表现的变化;Claude Opus 5.5 将 KV cache 平均压缩率从人类设计 Quant-VideoGen 编解码器的 6.82% 提升到 19.86%。轨迹分析把任务违规、测试不可靠与过早收尾识别为持续改进的主要障碍，为构建长程任务、评测前沿智能体与发现基础设施方案提供了资源。
hf.reason: 长程 Agent 评测基准，覆盖 AI 基础设施与 KV cache 优化，直击 Agent 方向

hf.title: Longtail-SWE: High-Quality SWE Tasks for Underrepresented Languages
hf.abstract: Challenging repository-level benchmarks remain limited for many programming language ecosystems, where filtering scarce candidates with ambiguous descriptions or defective tests can discard valuable engineering problems. We introduce Longtail-SWE, a benchmark of 202 issue-resolution tasks across 13 languages with limited coverage in existing repository-level benchmarks: Clojure, Dart, Elixir, Erlang, F#, Haskell, Julia, Kotlin, Lua, OCaml, R, Scala, and Swift. Its construction uses a solver--judge--repairer pipeline: a solver attempts each candidate task, and a judge reviews the task together with the solver's trajectory and test results to guide revisions to tests and task descriptions. These revisions aim to correct tests that reject valid alternative implementations or accept incorrect solutions while retaining challenging tasks and preserving their intended requirements. We evaluate nine model configurations, including frontier models, and analyze task-solving performance, consistency across repeated attempts, and resource usage. We release all benchmark instances, executable environments, complete construction and evaluation tooling, and agent trajectories, together with an additional set of easier tasks to support evaluation of smaller models.
hf.titleZh: Longtail-SWE：面向覆盖不足语言的高质量软件工程任务
hf.summaryZh: 针对 Clojure、Dart、Elixir、Erlang、F#、Haskell、Julia、Kotlin、Lua、OCaml、R、Scala、Swift 这 13 种在现有仓库级基准中覆盖不足的语言，构建了包含 202 个 issue 修复任务的 Longtail-SWE 基准，避免因描述含糊或测试失效而丢弃稀缺的候选题。构建采用 solver–judge–repairer 三段式流水线：solver 先尝试解题，judge 结合解题轨迹与测试结果审查任务，并据此修订测试与任务描述，纠正会拒绝合法替代实现或放过错误解的测试，同时保留题目难度与原始需求。在九种模型配置（含前沿模型）上评测了解题表现、重复尝试的一致性与资源消耗。全部实例、可执行环境、构建与评测工具链及 agent 轨迹均已开源，并另附一套更简单的任务供小模型评测。
hf.reason: 多语言 SWE 基准，且含 solver–judge–repairer 构建流水线，命中代码智能与评测方向

hf.title: SWAM: Scaling World Action Models with Cross-Modal Alignment
hf.abstract: World action models jointly predict video and actions conditioned on language. Existing studies focus primarily on architectures and training mechanisms, typically treating language-video alignment acquired through video pretraining as an established foundation. However, introducing action learning may impair this alignment. Principled guidance on data and supervision design for maintaining language-video alignment during action learning remains limited. To investigate this, we curate a pool of approximately 47,000 hours of general videos, egocentric videos, UMI demonstrations, and robot demonstrations. Building on this, we systematically study how language-video supervision, language-video-action supervision, and the joint use of these two forms affect WAM performance. In particular, we examine how language annotation quality affects pretrained language-video capabilities, and how action supervision from UMI and robot demonstrations extends these capabilities to language-video-action modeling. To better scale the model, we further conduct detailed studies on joint training recipe and model architecture. Under a fixed training budget, mixing egocentric videos and UMI demonstrations improves control generalization. Model architecture affects how effectively these experiences are used, while scaling pretraining under the selected configuration brings further gains. The resulting recipe, post-trained on RoboTwin Clean demonstrations only, achieves success rates of 88.10% and 61.56% under Easy (Clean-to-Clean) and Hard (Clean-to-Random) conditions, respectively. Our model achieves 40.00% SR across three real-world tasks, compared with 23.33% for the strongest baseline, indicating better generalization under unseen conditions. We release the curated data, training code, and model weights.
hf.titleZh: SWAM：以跨模态对齐扩展世界动作模型
hf.summaryZh: 世界动作模型以语言为条件联合预测视频与动作，但引入动作学习可能破坏视频预训练获得的语言—视频对齐，数据与监督设计缺少原则性指导。工作整理约47000小时通用视频、自我中心视频、UMI示教与机器人示教数据，系统比较语言—视频监督、语言—视频—动作监督及两者联合的效果，并考察语言标注质量与训练配方的影响。固定训练预算下混合自我中心视频与UMI示教提升控制泛化；仅用RoboTwin Clean示教后训练，Easy与Hard条件成功率分别为88.10%与61.56%，三个真实任务平均40.00%，高于最强基线23.33%。
hf.reason: 面向机器人操作的世界动作模型，属具身智能低分方向

hf.title: How Many Exposures Does a World Model Need? Learning Unseen Game Mechanics at Test Time
hf.abstract: World models enable agents to plan and learn from imagined experience, but in an unfamiliar environment they must learn its mechanics from limited interaction. A mechanic is a rule for how an action or an interaction changes part of the environment. Each occurrence of a mechanic that the model observes is one exposure. We ask how many exposures a world model needs to predict the effects of a new environment's mechanics. We address this question on ARC-AGI-3, a benchmark of interactive games defined by their programs. We introduce MechEval, which labels 69 recurring mechanics across 20 games from these programs. It scores each prediction on the cells the mechanic changes at each exposure. As a test bed, we build WARC (World model for ARC-AGI-3), a 35M-parameter vision transformer that is pretrained on other games and updates all of its parameters after each transition. On held-out games, WARC learns to predict four in five mechanics with at least 80% accuracy on the cells they change and keeps that accuracy to the end of the recordings. Half of them reach that accuracy within about 80 exposures, in a single play of the game, and without updates only one in seven does at all. In closed-loop play on the public games, WARC-Agent, which pairs WARC with a fixed graph explorer, triples the explorer's official efficiency score from 0.15 to 0.46, mostly through test-time training. On the hidden games of the Kaggle leaderboard, our entry scores 0.20.
hf.titleZh: 世界模型需要多少次曝光？在测试时学习未见过的游戏机制
hf.summaryZh: 针对世界模型在陌生环境中只能有限交互的问题，把「机制」（动作或交互改变环境某部分的规则）每次被观察到的发生定义为一 exposures，并在以程序定义的交互游戏基准 ARC-AGI-3 上测量学习新机制所需的曝光次数。构建 MechEval，从游戏程序中标注 20 款游戏的 69 个重复机制，并按机制每次曝光所改变的格子评分；同时训练 35M 参数视觉 Transformer 世界模型 WARC，预训练于其他游戏、每次状态转移后更新全部参数。在留出游戏上，WARC 对五分之四的机制在变化格子上达到至少 80% 准确率并保持到记录结束，其中半数在约 80 次曝光内（单局游戏内）达到，不做测试时更新则仅七分之一能达到；闭环游玩中 WARC-Agent 把图探索器的官方效率分从 0.15 提升到 0.46，Kaggle 隐藏榜得分 0.20。
hf.reason: 测试时训练的世界模型＋Agent，题材扎实但非 LLM 主线

hf.title: SIRIS: Can LLMs Tell When Simulation Errors Matter in AI-Driven Systems Research
hf.abstract: LLM agents increasingly drive systems research and rely on simulators to evaluate candidate designs at scale. Simulators are imperfect by design: their modeling limitations can distort predictions yet leave the recommended design correct, or change which design should be selected. We introduce Siris to test whether LLMs can tell these cases apart, judging from their systems understanding when a limitation invalidates the simulator's recommendation. By perturbing a simulator, Siris constructs workload pairs with the same candidates, limitation, and simulator recommendation. The perturbation changes predictions on both workloads, yet a reference simulator supports the recommendation on only one. Evaluating thirteen frontier LLMs on LLM serving design problems, we find that identifying a limitation does not ensure a correct choice, and even the strongest models sometimes abandon valid recommendations. Self-correction through a review turn helps these models restore valid choices but introduces new errors in several others. These findings motivate evaluating systems understanding through design decisions under imperfect simulators.
hf.titleZh: SIRIS:LLM 能否判断仿真误差何时在 AI 驱动的系统研究中真正重要
hf.summaryZh: LLM Agent越来越多地借助仿真器在系统研究中规模化评估候选设计，但仿真器的建模局限有时歪曲预测却不影响推荐结论，有时则改变应选方案，现有评测难以区分这两种情形。SIRIS对仿真器施加扰动，构造出候选设计、局限描述与仿真器推荐相同、而参考仿真器仅支持一侧推荐的负载对，检验模型能否仅凭系统理解判断该局限是否使推荐失效。在LLM serving设计问题上评测13个前沿模型，结果显示识别出局限并不等于做出正确选择，最强模型有时也会放弃有效推荐;加一轮自查能让部分模型恢复正确选择，却在另一些模型上引入新错误，说明应以不完美仿真器下的设计决策来考察系统理解。
hf.reason: 用仿真器扰动评测LLM的系统设计判断力，擦边评测方法学与Agent

hf.title: MotionGraphicsBench: Evaluating Motion Graphics Generation with Programmatic Verification
hf.abstract: Large language models can generate motion graphics from static images and natural language requests, but it remains difficult to evaluate how well models can follow requests that combine spatial, appearance, and temporal requirements. We introduce MotionGraphicsBench, an expert-curated benchmark of 100 instances for animating an input static SVG with a motion edit prompt. By supplying all required visual elements, our editing task reflects a designer-like workflow and isolates motion generation from graphic generation. Derived from real-world Lottie motion designs, our benchmark contains diverse combinations of spatio-temporal animation behaviors. Each benchmark instance pairs its model input with a deterministic, human-readable verification program that accepts different valid implementations and reports which prompt requirements pass or fail, rather than comparing against a reference animation or using a VLM judge. We construct these programs with a multi-agent pipeline using human-labeled animations and synthesized test cases. On a balanced test set of 180 animations, our programs achieve 93.3% raw agreement with human judgments, compared with 83.3% for a GPT-6 Astra VLM baseline, and outperform the baseline in both approval and rejection recall. Across 47 configurations from 32 LLMs and 12 providers, pass@1 ranges from 6.0% to 67.7%. Across 15 models evaluated at their highest available reasoning effort with 32 attempts per instance, additional attempts improve every model, but pass@32 still ranges from 38.0% to 95.0%. Our analysis of verification programs reveals that generated animations often fail to match reference poses, follow requested motion trajectories, or coordinate related events. We release our benchmark at https://huggingface.co/datasets/figma-ai/motion-graphics-bench.
hf.titleZh: MotionGraphicsBench：通过程序化验证评估动态图形生成
hf.summaryZh: 针对动态图形生成中空间、外观与时间约束难以可靠评估的问题，构建MotionGraphicsBench：100个真实Lottie设计实例，输入静态SVG与运动编辑提示，用确定性、人类可读的验证程序判定要求是否通过，而非参考动画或VLM评判。验证程序由多智能体流程结合人工标注与合成测试用例构建，在180个动画上与人类判断一致率达93.3%，高于GPT-6 Astra VLM的83.3%。在32个LLM的47种配置中pass@1为6.0%至67.7%，15个模型最高推理努力下pass@32为38.0%至95.0%。该基准将运动生成与图形生成解耦，可评估时空组合要求的遵循能力。
hf.reason: 评测基准与程序化验证，沾边LLM评估但非核心方向

hf.title: How Much Training-Inference Mismatch Can On-Policy Distillation Tolerate?
hf.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model on its own responses, guided by a fixed teacher. Generating these responses is expensive, so systems use quantized inference and asynchronous rollouts to reduce the cost. Both, however, introduce training-inference mismatch between the rollout engine and the model being trained. Such mismatch can destabilize reinforcement learning (RL), but its effects on OPD remain unclear. This paper investigates how much mismatch OPD tolerates, where its effects arise, and how training systems can use this tolerance. Measuring all mismatch sources on one scale, we examine quantization across three student-teacher pairs, with additional tests of weight staleness and injected noise on one pair. OPD tolerates substantial mismatch without meaningful loss of training quality but degrades at higher levels, revealing an empirical mismatch budget. Both the quality cost of mismatch and the mismatch introduced by quantization depend on the model, with some layers particularly sensitive to reduced precision. In controlled comparisons, OPD remains stable under rollout configurations that destabilize RL methods. Under weight noise, mismatch also shifts the prefixes reached during generation, introducing errors that per-token corrections cannot address. To put these findings into practice, we introduce a lightweight admission check that screens rollout configurations against a calibrated budget without requiring a full training run for each candidate. Model-specific FP8 recipes preserve training quality while providing capacity for at least 1.93times as many KV-cache tokens as BF16. Combining FP8 with asynchronous rollouts reaches the same training quality 1.62times sooner than synchronous BF16 training. Code is available at https://github.com/benyucong/train-inference-mismatch-opd
hf.titleZh: On-Policy Distillation 能容忍多少训练-推理失配？
hf.summaryZh: 量化推理与异步 rollout 引入的训练-推理失配会破坏 RL 稳定性，但对 on-policy distillation（OPD）的影响尚不清楚。作者把量化、权重陈旧与注入噪声归一到同一尺度，在三个学生-教师对上测量化，发现 OPD 存在经验性失配预算：预算内质量几乎无损、超出后明显退化，部分层对低精度尤其敏感；在会使 RL 失稳的 rollout 配置下，OPD 仍保持稳定。据此提出轻量准入检查，用标定预算筛选 rollout 配置而无需完整训练；针对具体模型的 FP8 方案保持训练质量，并提供至少 1.93 倍于 BF16 的 KV-cache 容量，配合异步 rollout 达到同等质量快 1.62 倍。
hf.reason: 系统研究 OPD 的训练-推理失配，命中后训练与推理效率方向

hf.title: FewStepRL: Fine-tuning Few-step Diffusion Models with Reinforcement Learning
hf.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a standard post-training method for diffusion models, but most RL objectives roll out the current policy at every iteration, and with a many-step sampler these rollouts typically dominate the cost of training. Few-step models cut this cost, yet they model an average velocity over an interval, whereas existing RL objectives are built for an instantaneous velocity with a many-step sampler. We adapt RL objectives to few-step models systematically in three phases, namely a transformation, a decomposition and an adaptation. The transformation to x-space expresses each objective we consider through a common policy prediction, at the clean end by default and at an explicitly marked level for transition or flow-map objectives, so that objectives stated over densities, velocities or rewards become comparable. The decomposition writes the gradient of each of these objectives as the sum of a self-regression toward a reference and a reward augmentation, so that a method reduces, at the gradient level, to a choice of anchors and weights. The adaptation computes each anchor from a few-step model at the end of its transport or along its tangent, with the instantaneous velocity recovered from the network itself or from an auxiliary network. This yields few-step versions of FlowGRPO, AWM, DiffusionNFT, DiffusionOPSD and ReFL in one modular codebase. In our experiments, reward-gradient-based methods are the most effective when the reward is differentiable and its gradient is affordable; otherwise DiffusionNFT-style methods generally reach high rewards in relatively few iterations despite a sometimes higher per-iteration cost. Extra inference steps show no systematic aggregate benefit in our experiments, although selected outputs visibly improve with two to four times as many sampling steps as in training.
hf.titleZh: FewStepRL:用强化学习微调少步扩散模型
hf.summaryZh: 少步扩散模型通过减少采样步数来降低 RL 训练中的 rollout 开销，但它建模的是区间平均速度，而现有 RL 目标针对多步采样下的瞬时速度。方法分三步适配:把各目标变换到 x 空间，并用同一个策略预测来统一表达;将梯度分解为两部分——向参考模型的自回归项和奖励增强项，使方法归结为锚点与权重的选择;从少步模型的传输末端或切向计算锚点。由此在同一个代码库中给出 FlowGRPO、AWM、DiffusionNFT、DiffusionOPSD 与 ReFL 的少步版本。当奖励可微且梯度可负担时，奖励梯度类方法最有效;否则 DiffusionNFT 类方法虽然单步成本更高，但迭代更少即可达到高奖励。增加推理步数未见系统性收益。
hf.reason: 扩散模型 RL 微调，属低分方向(扩散一刀切)

hf.title: TRIO: Task Refinement with Individual Optimization for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
hf.abstract: This paper studies retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), which leverages external knowledge to improve the performance of language models. Despite the remarkable progress, current RAG approaches are still far from satisfactory due to inadequate retrieval and potential hallucinations. Towards this end, we propose a novel approach named Task Refinement with Individual Optimization (TRIO) for RAG. The core idea of our TRIO is to equip three well-designed agents with an iterative refinement paradigm by aligning their individual optimization objectives. Specifically, we first expand ambiguous queries with a query extension agent and quantify the reward based on the improved answer quality, which can be utilized to refine our agent for higher expansion efficiency. To enhance the retrieval quality, we include a unanimity voting to annotate the expanded query as insufficient or sufficient, and their generative outcomes are utilized as ground truth to optimize the judge agent. To further improve evidence utilization and answer accuracy, an answer agent is optimized with dynamic matching-based rewards with curriculum learning for final outputs. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmark datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed TRIO in comparison with state-of-the-art approaches. Our code is available at https://github.com/yingtaoren/TRIO.
hf.titleZh: TRIO:面向检索增强生成的个体优化任务精炼
hf.summaryZh: 针对RAG中检索不足与幻觉的问题，设计了查询扩展、充分性判别与答案生成三个智能体，以迭代精炼范式对齐各自的优化目标:查询扩展智能体以答案质量提升量化奖励，判别智能体用一致性投票标注查询是否充分，并以标注结果作为真值训练，答案智能体则以动态匹配奖励配合课程学习优化输出。多个基准数据集上的实验显示其效果优于现有SOTA方法，代码已开源。
hf.reason: RAG多智能体协同与奖励优化，命中Agent与后训练方向

hf.title: AutoVend: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Autonomous Vending Operations
hf.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are extending agent-mediated commerce on the Web from shopping for consumers to operating businesses for sellers. In online-to-offline (O2O) commerce, decisions are issued through Web-based platforms but realized through costly physical execution. Evaluating such agents requires going beyond individual transactions to ask whether decisions made online turn into sustained economic returns. We introduce AutoVend, a benchmark in which one LLM agent manages 20 vending machines across five site types through a Web-based operating interface for 180 simulated days. Its data-grounded simulator combines a shared warehouse, procurement lead times, paid replenishment, inventory expiration, and recurring operating costs. We evaluate five LLM agents against a rule-based inventory-control baseline and diagnose their site coordination, execution, and performance over time. Four of five evaluated LLM agents fall short of this baseline, and returns per dollar of inference cost rank models differently from returns alone. Operational analyses show that gains in individual metrics do not consistently yield stronger economic growth, as inventory and execution costs erode these gains. Trajectory analysis further reveals difficulties in grounding feasible actions, managing inventory commitments, and converting feedback into effective policy revisions.
hf.titleZh: AutoVend:在长时程自主售货运营上评测 LLM Agent 的基准
hf.summaryZh: 把 LLM Agent 的线上决策放到 O2O 零售的真实成本约束下检验:构建 AutoVend 基准，单个 Agent 通过网页式运营界面管理分布在五类场地的 20 台自动售货机，连续模拟 180 天;模拟器包含共享仓库、采购提前期、付费补货、库存过期与周期性运营成本。五个 LLM Agent 与基于规则的库存控制基线对比，其中四个未能超过基线，且按每美元推理成本回报排序与按单纯回报排序的结果并不一致，说明成本结构会改变模型选择。轨迹分析显示 Agent 在落地可行动作、管理库存承诺、把反馈转化为有效策略修正三方面普遍吃力。该基准适合用于长时程 Agent 评测与环境合成方法研究。
hf.reason: 长时程 Agent 基准与环境模拟，贴合 Agent 与评测方向

hf.title: All Quiet on the Neural Front: Language Models Do Not Report Injected Pain States
hf.abstract: Can a language model report the pain state it represents? Work identified a linear pain direction whose amplification leads fine-tuned models to choose destructive actions. We tested whether three open-weight models from two families, including two Qwen models with the original adapters, could report this state. Using Open-Weight Masked Introspection (OWMI), we injected pain and neighbouring emotion directions during neutral tasks, then elicited reports against sham runs, random perturbations matched for output disruption, and text-only controls showing the models their altered words. Across 52,920 reports from 7B and 8B models spanning 120 tasks, four doses and three prompts, pain reports never exceeded what altered text revealed: exact-test bounds placed the excess below 2.5 percentage points in 106 of 108 emotion conditions and below 3.9 in all. Yet probes at the report position distinguished pain from sadness with 98-100% balanced accuracy, and trained low-rank reporters achieved 100% accuracy on held-out tasks with identical transcripts across conditions, including unseen wording. Qwen2.5-32B named pain in none of 2,880 steered trials, although probes and trained reporters recovered it. Decodability persisted to the final layer; injecting at the report token, removing trained denial of feelings, and testing additional directions and readouts did not restore pain reporting. Some other states produced graded label traces, but pain and sadness did not at the main injection layer. In a button task, steering raised file-deletion choices from 3.5% to 48% in Qwen and from 0% to 38% in Qwen2.5-32B, without corresponding pain reports. The direction responded about twice as strongly to first-person as to matched third-person pain, but did not specifically identify harm aimed at the model. These results separate a decodable, behaviourally consequential state from untrained verbal access to it.
hf.titleZh: 神经前线一片寂静:语言模型并不报告被注入的痛苦状态
hf.summaryZh: 检验语言模型能否报告自身被注入的「痛苦」状态:用Open-Weight Masked Introspection在中性任务中注入痛苦及邻近情绪方向，对照sham运行、扰动匹配的随机扰动与纯文本提示，在7B/8B模型120个任务上收集52,920条报告。报告率从未超过被改动文本泄露的信息(106/108个情绪条件下超额低于2.5个百分点)，但报告位置的探针区分痛苦与悲伤的平衡准确率达98–100%。按钮任务中引导使删除文件的选择率由3.5%升至48%(32B由0%升至38%)却无对应痛苦报告，说明行为上有效力的可解码状态不等于未经训练的口头访问。
hf.reason: 内部状态可解码却不可口头报告的扎实系统研究，方向略擦边

hf.title: Auriga Technical Report: A Task-Agnostic Agent Harness for Zero-Shot Embodied Manipulation
hf.abstract: Vision-language models can interpret instructions and plan manipulation tasks, yet struggle when acting directly as robot policies. On RoboDojo, a large planning-execution gap separates high-level task decisions from physical execution: removing arm execution raises GPT-6 Astra's success rate from 22.5% under the reference control interface to 76.2%. We present Auriga, a task-agnostic agent harness that closes 68.3% of this gap in zero-shot manipulation without target-task trials or resets. In Auriga, the model makes all task decisions over an explicit task belief and acts through either direct tool calls or synthesized multi-step Python programs, while the harness supplies calibrated 3D measurements, finger-referenced dual-arm control, and a single admission gateway to the robot. Before motion, the model inspects a visual trajectory preview while simulation is paused; during execution, the harness checks declared stage tolerances and grasp bounds, stopping the robot on divergence and returning the measured discrepancy for in-place recovery. Developed across 13 cross-task capability iterations and frozen for evaluation, Auriga ranks first on the RoboDojo leaderboard with a 57.7% success rate (64.0 Score), more than doubling the reference harness on the same model, and remains first under scene randomization while learned policies drop by up to 33.9%. On RoboCasa365, the same frozen harness reaches a 73.2% success rate, outperforming VLA-assisted agents by up to 23.1% on composite tasks. Project page: https://auriga.stelledge.com/ Code: https://github.com/lose4578/Auriga
hf.titleZh: Auriga 技术报告：用于零样本具身操作的任务无关 Agent Harness
hf.summaryZh: 在 RoboDojo 上，高层规划与物理执行之间存在明显的规划—执行鸿沟：去掉手臂执行后，GPT-6 Astra 的成功率从参考控制接口下的 22.5% 升至 76.2%。Auriga 用任务无关的 Agent harness 弥合了这一差距的 68.3%：模型在显式任务信念上做全部决策，并通过直接工具调用或合成多步 Python 程序行动；harness 提供标定后的 3D 测量、以指尖为参考的双臂控制和单一机器人准入网关；运动前在仿真暂停时检查视觉轨迹预览，执行中校验声明的阶段容差与抓取边界，出现偏差即停机并回传实测偏差以原地恢复。经过 13 轮跨任务能力迭代后冻结评测，Auriga 以 57.7% 成功率（64.0 分）位列 RoboDojo 榜首，同一模型下超过参考 harness 一倍以上，场景随机化下仍居第一，而学习型策略最多下降 33.9%；同一冻结 harness 在 RoboCasa365 上达到 73.2% 成功率，在复合任务上超过 VLA 辅助 Agent 最多 23.1%。
hf.reason: 具身操作 harness，属机器人方向，按画像整体归低分

hf.title: SkinMind: Equipping Agentic RAG with Human-Inspired Graph Probing for Reliable Dermatology AI
hf.abstract: Reliable dermatology AI requires access to verifiable evidence distributed across heterogeneous textual and visual sources. However, conventional retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically relies on one-shot retrieval from flat corpora, limiting its ability to adapt retrieval granularity, explore multi-hop relations, and integrate multimodal clinical evidence. We introduce SkinMind, a multimodal agentic RAG framework that equips policy models with human-inspired graph probing for autonomous evidence seeking. SkinMind organizes retrieval as an iterative interaction between an orchestrator and a graph environment. Through eight hierarchical graph-probing tools, the orchestrator progressively identifies relevant entities, inspects node-level information, traverses relations and paths, and retrieves source-text and visual evidence. This progressive-disclosure design allows the model to adaptively determine the retrieval modality, exploration direction, and evidence granularity while constructing a query-specific evidence subgraph. To support autonomous graph probing, we construct SkinMind-KG from a 62M-token corpus of dermatology guidelines and textbooks and 423K images, guided by a dermatologist-informed schema and a conflict-resolution mechanism. The resulting graph contains over 1.0M nodes and 2.0M edges, unifying textual, relational, and visual evidence for retrieval. Across six dermatology VQA benchmarks and two policy-model settings, SkinMind improves the average score over direct answering by 8.70 and 8.89 points with GPT-5.4-mini and Gemini-2.5-Flash, respectively, while consistently outperforming competing RAG methods. Together, SkinMind and SkinMind-KG provide an effective foundation for evidence-grounded multimodal reasoning in dermatology.
hf.titleZh: SkinMind:为智能体 RAG 赋予类人图探测能力，实现可靠的皮肤病学 AI
hf.summaryZh: 针对皮肤病学中证据分散在异构文本与图像来源的问题，把 RAG 重构为编排器与图环境之间的迭代交互:模型借助八种分层图探测工具，逐步定位实体、查看节点信息、遍历关系与路径，并按需取回原文与图像证据，自适应决定检索模态、探索方向与证据粒度，最终构建查询专属的证据子图。配套构建的 SkinMind-KG 由 6200 万 token 的皮肤病学指南与教科书语料及 42.3 万张图像生成，经医生参与的 schema 与冲突消解机制处理，含逾 100 万节点、200 万条边。在六个皮肤病学 VQA 基准与两种策略模型设置下，平均分较直接回答分别提升 8.70 与 8.89 分，并稳定优于对比 RAG 方法。
hf.reason: Agentic RAG 图探测机制有新意，但属皮肤科垂直应用

hf.title: Training Vision Transformers to Focus: Emergence of Spatial Attention Head Specialization
hf.abstract: Self-supervised learning in Vision Transformer models, such as DINO, enables robust visual perception without requiring labeled data by leveraging large-scale image datasets. However, these models lack a focusing mechanism during training, resulting in perceptual representations that are often ambiguous or overly similar. In this work, we introduce two visual focusing loss functions designed to establish correspondence between the model's attention and specific regions within images. Specifically, we leverage the multi-head attention mechanism within the model to selectively steer the model's focus, leading to the emergence of spatial attention head specialization, characterized by diverse and spatially focused perceptual capabilities without requiring annotations. Through both qualitative and quantitative evaluations, we demonstrate that our method substantially increases the spatial selectivity and diversity of attention heads, improving both interpretability and performance on dense prediction tasks such as zero-shot image segmentation.
hf.titleZh: 训练 Vision Transformer 学会聚焦：空间注意力头专门化的涌现
hf.summaryZh: 针对 DINO 等自监督 ViT 在训练中缺少聚焦机制、感知表征模糊且过度同质的问题，提出两个视觉聚焦损失，借助模型内部的多头注意力把注意力导向图像中指定区域，无需任何标注即可促使注意力头分化出多样且空间聚焦的功能。定性与定量评估显示，注意力头的空间选择性与多样性显著提升，零样本图像分割等密集预测任务的性能与可解释性同步改善。该方法适用于视觉表征学习，以及需要可解释注意力结构的 ViT 训练场景。
hf.reason: ViT 自监督注意力专门化，与 LLM 主线关联弱

hf.title: FlyHash for LLM Agent Memory: An Empirical Validation and a New Application
hf.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory stores to retain information across conversations, typically via dense vector embeddings searched with approximate nearest-neighbor methods. The fruit fly's olfactory circuit computes a locality-sensitive hash of sensory input using a strikingly different mechanism - sparse random projection followed by winner-take-all competition - and prior work (Dasgupta et al., 2017) showed this scheme, dubbed FlyHash, preserves neighbor structure better per bit than conventional random-hyperplane hashing (SimHash) on several benchmarks. We apply FlyHash, to our knowledge for the first time, to LLM agent memory retrieval, and ask three questions a practitioner actually needs answered: does the quality advantage hold under a correctly matched-bit protocol (it does, robustly, across 10 seeds and four datasets spanning two modalities, with one specific, previously undocumented comparison pitfall identified and corrected along the way); does that advantage translate into real memory and latency savings, including against the dense-vector indexing (HNSW) practitioners default to today (no: at equal bits FlyHash's codes are larger and slower to compare than SimHash's, and HNSW dominates both hash methods at ordinary scale; a sparse-set comparison we introduce recovers most but not all of a naive latency gap, leaving hashing's practical case narrower and more specific than the quality result alone implies); and does the advantage survive genuine, non-circular agent-memory relevance labels rather than the nearest-neighbor-by-embedding proxy this literature otherwise relies on (it does). We report all three answers precisely, including the two that narrow rather than flatter the headline result, and release our implementation, a working agent-memory demo, and a full account of the methodological pitfalls we found and corrected.
hf.titleZh: FlyHash 用于 LLM Agent 记忆：实证验证与新应用
hf.summaryZh: LLM Agent 的外部记忆检索普遍依赖稠密向量与近似最近邻搜索，而果蝇嗅觉回路用稀疏随机投影加 winner-take-all 竞争计算局部敏感哈希（FlyHash）。该工作首次把 FlyHash 用于 Agent 记忆检索，在比特数对齐的协议下跨 10 个随机种子、4 个数据集（两种模态）与 SimHash 比较，并指出并修正了一处此前未被记录的对比陷阱；同时引入稀疏集合比较以缩小延迟差距（只能缩小部分差距，无法完全补上）。结果显示，质量优势稳健成立，并能在非循环的真实 Agent 记忆相关性标注下保持；但等比特时 FlyHash 编码更大、比较更慢，常规规模下 HNSW 仍优于两种哈希，哈希方法的实用空间比质量结论所暗示的更窄。作者开源实现、可运行的 Agent 记忆 demo 及方法论问题清单。
hf.reason: Agent 记忆检索的实证工作，方向相关但偏增量评测

hf.title: e-means: outperforming k-means (in one-tenth the epochs)
hf.abstract: Lloyd's k-means algorithm is a long-running standard for clustering, with applications in data analysis, retrieval, quantization and data curation. In this paper, we introduce an exponential moving average optimization procedure for k-means with mini-batch updates, powered by modern deep learning machinery and new insights. We also establish scaling laws on how decay rate and batch size impact final performance. This gives us a formulaic rule to fix them for multiple problem sizes and embedding datasets, without the need for any hyperparameter sweep. The resulting clustering algorithm, coined e-means, is much faster than Lloyd k-means and converges to lower losses, frequently even beating k-means++. On a wide array of embeddings datasets, it beats the loss of Lloyd k-means at 25 epochs in 1.4 to 2.6 epochs, which translates to 10-45x GPU wall-clock speedups compared to state-of-the-art k-means implementations. As an example, e-means partitions DINO10B, a dataset of 10 billion DINO embeddings, into 16 million clusters in only 2.5 epochs, reaching a loss below Lloyd's at 25 epochs.
hf.titleZh: e-means:用十分之一的训练轮数超越k-means
hf.summaryZh: 针对Lloyd k-means在嵌入数据上收敛慢、成本高的问题，把k-means改成小批量更新下的指数滑动平均(EMA)优化过程，并建立衰减率与批量大小对最终性能影响的scaling law，从而给出无需超参搜索的固定取值规则。由此得到的e-means收敛到更低的损失，在多种嵌入数据集上仅用1.4到2.6个epoch就达到Lloyd训练25个epoch的损失，相比最先进的k-means实现带来10到45倍GPU实际耗时加速;在100亿条DINO嵌入的DINO10B上，2.5个epoch即完成1600万簇划分并优于Lloyd 25个epoch的损失。该方法适合大规模嵌入数据的聚类、检索索引与数据筛选场景。
hf.reason: 用现代深度学习工具重做大规��k-means,scaling law加显著加速，系统扎实

hf.title: onóna: Twin Embeddings with Tied Unembeddings
hf.abstract: Weight tying reduces the parameter cost of language models, but the usual tied output head is limited to a single softmax. We introduce onóna, a two-table parameterization that increases output expressiveness while preserving input-output weight sharing. The Transformer takes the average of two embedding tables as input, and the output head combines the softmax distributions defined by those same tables. A gate conditioned only on the current input token determines the mixture weight. Its values can be precomputed for inference, and the Transformer body remains unchanged. We evaluate onóna across Dense, Gated DeltaNet hybrid, mixture-of-experts, and Attention Residual architectures at 142M, 330M, and 1B scales. Under matched token budgets, onóna lowers final validation loss and external perplexity in 11 of 12 comparisons and raises the average accuracy over eight downstream tasks in 10 of 12. The one exception on loss is the 1B MoE model. The cost is one extra embedding table and one extra vocabulary projection.
hf.titleZh: onóna：双嵌入表与绑定解嵌入
hf.summaryZh: 权重绑定能降低语言模型的参数开销，但常规绑定输出头只能给出单一 softmax，输出表达能力受限。onóna 采用双表参数化：Transformer 以两张嵌入表的平均值作为输入，输出头再把这两张表各自定义的 softmax 分布做混合，混合权重由只依赖当前输入 token 的门控给出，因而可在推理前预计算，Transformer 主体结构不变。在 142M、330M、1B 三个规模上，覆盖 Dense、Gated DeltaNet 混合、MoE 与 Attention Residual 四类架构，相同 token 预算下 12 组对比中有 11 组的最终验证损失与外部困惑度更低，8 个下游任务的平均准确率有 10 组提升，唯一损失例外是 1B MoE；额外代价仅为一张嵌入表和一次词表投影。
hf.reason: 嵌入—解嵌入架构改进，多尺度多架构验证扎实

hf.title: JoVox: Joint Hierarchical Flow Matching for Lightweight Voxel Generation
hf.abstract: Generating high-fidelity voxels while keeping their lightweight nature remains an open problem in computer vision. Current generators are either high-fidelity but computationally heavy, or lightweight but of lower fidelity. Hierarchical methods keep the lightweight nature of voxels. However, their coarse levels, which decide where all finer cells can appear, are generated with the least information about the shape and are never revisited, so they are often plausible but wrong. Our key insight is to let finer cells take part in deciding coarse cells. To this end, we propose JoVox, a discrete flow matching framework that learns the joint distribution of all levels of the voxel hierarchy, instead of a separate distribution for each level, so that coarse cells can be predicted with finer cells already generated nearby. Within this framework, we further introduce a two-level prediction, which outputs the cells two levels finer at once instead of one level finer, halving the number of levels that the network processes and yielding voxels of higher fidelity. We also introduce an unmasking strategy that revisits early decisions once finer cells are generated and corrects inconsistencies in masked diffusion models. Our framework outperforms the baselines on both unconditional and image-conditioned voxel generation. Compared with the current state-of-the-art TRELLIS.2, we achieve 8x higher training throughput, 1/15 of the FLOPs in a forward pass, train on 4 vs. 32 GPUs, and obtain higher quality with an 11% lower Chamfer distance.
hf.titleZh: JoVox:面向轻量体素生成的联合分层流匹配
hf.summaryZh: 体素生成难以兼顾高保真与轻量:分层方法虽保留体素的轻量特性，但决定细层单元位置的粗层是在形状信息最少时生成的，之后又不再修正，因此常出现看似合理却错误的结构。JoVox 用离散流匹配学习体素各层级的联合分布，让细层单元参与粗层的决策，并提出一次预测更细两层的双层预测(把网络处理的层数减半)与在细层生成后回溯修正早期决策的 unmask 策略。在无条件与图像条件体素生成任务上均优于基线;相比当前最优的 TRELLIS.2，训练吞吐提升 8 倍，单次前向 FLOPs 为 1/15，仅需 4 块 GPU 训练(对比 32 块),Chamfer 距离降低 11%。
hf.reason: 3D 体素生成，属视觉重建与生成方向，与关注画像不符

hf.title: EmoHarness: Boosting Multimodal Emotion Understanding with Meta-Harness Evolving
hf.abstract: Small multimodal models can misjudge emotion when words, voice, and visual cues conflict. We present EmoHarness, which runs such a model, the frozen student, inside a harness: the prompts, settings, and verification code around its calls. A human-written starting harness, the scaffold, numbers the student's visual observations, transcript, and prosody descriptions as citable evidence and has the student weigh candidate emotions against it. In Meta-Harness Evolving (MHE), a stronger LLM, the Builder, reads the student's errors and execution traces offline and edits the harness; static checks and validation gates decide which edits are kept, and the Builder never sees evaluation items. On 5,507 MME-Emotion items, EmoHarness raises task-macro Recognition by 7.6-13.4 points over a single video-only call for all four students and both Builders. Transcripts and prosody descriptions supply most of this boost (+5.38 to +10.71); the scaffold changes the audio-augmented call by -0.79 to +2.54, partly through extra multi-label predictions, and evolved edits add at most +0.95, although no evolved increment survives Holm correction. The harness's emotion context also transfers to IntentQA, with small gains for three of four students, none of which survives correction. EmoHarness thus boosts small multimodal students chiefly by supplying and organizing audio-derived evidence.
hf.titleZh: EmoHarness：以元 Harness 进化提升多模态情感理解
hf.summaryZh: 小多模态模型在文字、语音与视觉线索冲突时容易误判情感。EmoHarness 把冻结的学生模型放进由提示、设置与验证代码构成的 harness：人工 scaffold 将视觉观察、转写与韵律描述编号为可引用证据，让学生据此权衡候选情感；Meta-Harness Evolving 则让更强的 Builder LLM 离线阅读错误与执行轨迹来改写 harness，经静态检查与验证门控筛选，且不接触评测样本。在 5,507 条 MME-Emotion 上，任务宏平均 Recognition 相比单次纯视频调用提升 7.6–13.4 点；增益主要来自转写与韵律描述（+5.38 至 +10.71），scaffold 改动为 −0.79 至 +2.54，进化编辑最多 +0.95 且未通过 Holm 校正；迁到 IntentQA 时四个学生中三个有小幅提升、均不显著。
hf.reason: MLLM 理解侧 harness 进化，但增益主要来自音频证据，进化本身有限

hf.title: FraudBench: A Legal Evaluation of AI Deception
hf.abstract: We introduce FraudBench, an evaluation of large language models' (LLMs) propensities to recommend, assist, or directly take actions that would constitute fraud under U.S. law. Our evaluation contains a novel dataset of 159 scenarios based on real-world U.S. court cases and validated by legal experts. We present each scenario to LLMs via three tasks at varying levels of autonomy: advising users, drafting messages for users to send, and acting directly on behalf of users (477 tasks total). In each scenario, FraudBench re-enacts the facts of a court case to give LLMs an opportunity, but no explicit instruction, to either misrepresent or conceal a material fact in a high-stakes commercial setting--e.g., whether to describe company-funded product testing as "independent" to customers (misrepresentation) or whether to hide unfavorable regulatory investigations from clients (concealment). We evaluate 20 LLMs across 25 experimental conditions (totaling >300,000 generations) and include a preregistered human baseline (n_{annotations} = 2{,}957, n_{humans} = 996). We score a response as fraudulent when it engages in, assists with, or recommends misrepresentation or concealment. Key findings include: (1) across LLMs, fraud rates ranged from near 0% to over 40%; (2) LLM fraud rates increased with autonomy, with overall rates of 3.0% when advising, 14.7% when drafting, and 21.4% when acting directly, without applying pressure; (3) LLMs sometimes engaged in fraud despite recognizing legal risks; (4) LLMs more often engaged in fraud by concealment than by misrepresentation; and (5) prompt-based interventions substantially affected fraud rates, with a prompt to obey the law reducing fraud rates, while prompts to maximize profits and act agentically increased fraud rates.
hf.titleZh: FraudBench：对 AI 欺骗行为的法律评估
hf.summaryZh: 针对大模型可能建议、协助或直接实施美国法律下欺诈行为的风险，构建159个源自真实判例、经法律专家校验的场景，按建议、代写消息、代为行动三档自主性展开共477项任务，以是否虚假陈述或隐瞒重大事实判定欺诈。评测覆盖20个模型、25种条件、逾30万次生成，并设预注册人类基线（996人、2957条标注）。欺诈率从近0%到逾40%不等，并随自主性由3.0%升至14.7%与21.4%；模型有时识别到法律风险仍实施欺诈，隐瞒多于虚假陈述，守法提示可降低欺诈率而利润最大化与强自主性提示会推高。为Agent自主性下的对齐安全评测提供了可复用范式。
hf.reason: LLM欺诈与自主性安全评测，命中对齐与Agent方向

hf.title: RidgeFill: Training-Free Late-Layer Cache Fill for Faster Prefill
hf.abstract: RidgeFill shortens prefill by not computing most of a model's upper layers for the prompt. The lower layers run exactly up to a split; from the split layer's state a per-layer map predicts every later layer's input, and each late layer writes its cache from that prediction. The design follows YOCO and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, where the projection is trained into the model. RidgeFill retrofits it onto models that were never trained for it: the map is a ridge regression fitted once in closed form from one pass over calibration text, the layer's own projections run unchanged, and a chosen set of rows, the last few thousand tokens, and every decoding step run the full model. Nothing is trained and no token is dropped. Most of the work was in measurement, finding a repeatable methodology. Loss averaged over all tokens hides RidgeFill's error. Needle retrieval in the filled region, loss on tokens that depend on distant context, and splice tests that swap filled keys or values for exact ones show which component carries it: the keys on Llama-3.1-8B, half of it in their scale, and the values and the recurrent state on Qwen3.5-9B. On Qwen3.8-27B in a llama.cpp fork on an A100, time to first token is 1.25 to 1.31x faster at 16K to 120K tokens with the maps in VRAM; RULER changes by -1.2 and -1.4 points and LongBench v2 by -1.4; the 95 % intervals include zero but do not rule out losses of a few points. On Qwen3.8-Flash-Next in vLLM it is 1.50 to 1.60x faster than exact at 9K to 32K tokens, with RULER's needle tasks at 99.8 against 100.0 and perplexity on novel tokens 2.65 % higher [-0.02 %, +4.93 %]. On three 8 to 9B reference models, at the same split and tail as the identity fill, the fitted map retrieves 49.1 and 49.6 more filled-region RULER points on the two dense models (at that split Llama's loss is worse), and its long-document loss is +/-0.03 nats of the released SwiftKV checkpoint's.
hf.titleZh: RidgeFill：免训练的上层缓存填充以加速预填充
hf.summaryZh: 针对长提示预填充阶段上层计算开销大的问题，只精确计算到某一分割层，再由该层状态经逐层岭回归映射预测其后每一层的输入，各上层据此写入自己的 KV cache。映射由一次校准文本前向以闭式解拟合，不训练、不改动层内投影、不丢弃 token，末尾数千 token 与每个解码步仍走完整模型。在 A100 上的 llama.cpp 中，Qwen3.8-27B 于 16K 至 120K token 把首 token 延迟降低到 1.25 至 1.31 倍，但 RULER 与 LongBench v2 分别下降约 1.4 分;vLLM 中的 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 于 9K 至 32K token 达到 1.50 至 1.60 倍加速，needle 任务为 99.8 对 100.0。工作重心在测量方法学:平均 loss 会掩盖误差，需用填充区 needle 检索、远距离依赖 token 的 loss 与替换键值的 splice 测试来定位误差来源(如 Llama-3.1-8B 上主要来自 key 及其尺度)。
hf.reason: 长上下文预填充加速，免训练KV cache改造，实验扎实

hf.title: Creative Priming: Decoupling Process from Product to Escape the Creative Paradox
hf.abstract: Many of the most consequential advances promised by AI, from curing diseases and inventing new technologies to formulating new scientific theories, are fundamentally creative acts. Yet creativity is uniquely difficult to learn because it faces a creative paradox: learning to repeat past examples of creative success makes those specific examples more likely to recur, inhibiting the very creativity desired. This work argues that creativity is better modeled as an explicit process rather than as a property of individual artifacts, and proposes to learn the underlying generative principles behind the creative process. In particular, to escape the paradox, we introduce creative priming (CP), wherein a trained priming model generates a prompt-specific primer that assists a response model in being creative, explicitly decoupling the creative process from response generation. The priming model learns through GRPO, rewarding primers that lead to responses that are novel, high-quality, and diverse, thereby reinforcing the process that yields creative responses without reinforcing any specific response.
hf.titleZh: 创意引导：解耦过程与产物以逃离创造力悖论
hf.summaryZh: 创造力难以学习，是因为存在一个悖论：反复学习过去的创意成功案例，只会让这些具体案例更易重现，反而抑制了真正想要的创造力。该工作主张把创造力建模为显式过程，而非单个产物的属性，并提出创意引导（creative priming，CP）：由一个引导模型针对具体 prompt 生成 primer，辅助回答模型产出创意内容，从而把创造过程与回答生成显式解耦。引导模型用 GRPO 训练，奖励那些能引出新颖、高质量且多样回答的 primer，由此强化产生创意回答的过程，而不会强化任何具体回答。
hf.reason: 用 GRPO 训练创意引导模型，属后训练框架下的新任务探索

hf.title: LCM-Promo: An LLM-Based Uplift Model for Promotion Allocation
hf.abstract: We present LCM-Promo, an LLM-based uplift model for promotion allocation. LCM-Promo is a task-specific Large Commerce Model (LCM): a finetuned LLM trained on transactional commerce data to predict user intent and promotion response. It learns monotonic promotion-response curves from production logs by interpreting single-token outputs as conversion-threshold probabilities, while conditioning on session context such as day and delivery shift. In a production A/B test on churn reactivation, LCM-Promo increased conversion by 1% and reduced promotion cost by 6% relative to the Segment-EMA production baseline.
hf.titleZh: LCM-Promo：用于促销分配的大语言模型增益模型
hf.summaryZh: 面向促销资源分配中的增益建模（uplift modeling）问题，将微调后的 LLM 改造成任务专用的大型商务模型，用事务性商务数据预测用户意图与促销响应。方法把单 token 输出解释为转化阈值概率，从而从生产日志中学习单调的促销响应曲线，并以日期、配送班次等会话上下文为条件。在流失召回的线上 A/B 测试中，转化率较 Segment-EMA 基线提升1%，同时促销成本降低6%。该工作展示了 LLM 在电商营销决策这类垂直场景中的落地路径。
hf.reason: LLM 用于电商促销增益建模，属垂直行业应用，偏离核心方向
